deployments_detail.use: SmartHQ Assistant — a conversational generative-AI helper in GE Appliances' SmartHQ consumer app that answers customer questions about their registered connected appliances (e.g., water-filter replacement, cleaning, maintenance) using GE's product documentation, replacing the need to find printed manuals. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI)]

小优 (Xiaoyou) home-service intelligent agent on the Three-Wing-Bird (三翼鸟) Uhome large model — an AI household 'butler' providing AI voice and AI vision services: helps the fridge log ingredients, watches the range hood for pot boil-over to coordinate stove heat, and has washing machines count/recognize laundry, moving from assisting housework toward 'unmanned housework'. [Haier (Three-Wing-Bird Uhome large model)]
Cross-listed (also in CSI300) — "HomeGPT", "AI Eye" cooking agent, COSMOPlat

HomeGPT / Smart Home Brain (智家大脑) — Haier's proprietary vertical-domain large language model for the home, described as China's first large-scale model in the smart-home sector. Trained on billions of home-life data points to understand user behavior, device state and environment, powering proactive whole-home scene automation (lighting, temperature, air quality) across Haier's Three-Wing-Bird ecosystem. [Haier proprietary (HomeGPT / UhomeGPT, UhomeOS)]

Flavorly AI — a generative-AI recipe feature in the SmartHQ app that creates customized recipes based on the food users have on hand (later adding visual recognition of fridge contents/dishes) plus dietary preferences, to reduce food waste; integrated with Instacart shopping. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI)]

SmartHQ AI appliance assistants — the AI Laundry Assistant (voice/text stain and fabric-care guidance, auto-optimizing wash settings on GE Profile 955 Series), the AI Coffee Assistant (personalized brewing profiles), and a General Assistant (measurement conversions, ingredient substitutions, cooking temps, maintenance tips). [Google Cloud generative AI]

COSMOPlat industrial-internet platform with the self-developed COSMOMind / Tianzhi industrial large model — full-stack AI (training/inference platform, large models, agent platforms) offering 57 industrial intelligent agents across 40+ core scenarios in home appliances, energy/chemicals and energy-carbon industries; e.g. 38 petrochemical agents and a dynamometer diagnosis assistant. [Haier COSMOPlat (COSMOMind / Tianzhi 天智 industrial large model)]
deployments_detail.value: 57 industrial agents across 40+ scenarios; 93% industrial-knowledge retrieval accuracy; petrochemical agents avg +20% efficiency, failure-diagnosis efficiency +50%

deployments_detail.use: COSMOPlat (Kaos) AI energy-optimization deployment at a Hebei steel/industrial plant using the '能源小智' (energy intelligent-control) system plus hardware upgrades and blockchain verification of savings, under a results-based (shared-savings) commercial model. [Haier COSMOPlat (能源小智 energy control system)]
deployments_detail.value: 31% electricity reduction in first month (vs 25% target); ~7M yuan/yr electricity savings; 26,000+ tons carbon reduction/yr

deployments_detail.use: AI Eye 2.0 / AI Vision — computer-vision AI embedded in Haier's Seeker-series appliances (L4-level certified): refrigerators recognize nearly all ingredients and auto-adjust preservation, washing machines detect clothing state and warn of mixed colors/overflow, range hoods/stoves detect pot contents and auto-adjust heat, and air conditioners use UWB radar positioning for personalized airflow — running on UhomeOS with a home-scenario vertical model. [Haier proprietary (AI Eye 2.0 / AI Vision, UhomeOS, Haimily on-device model)]

GE Appliances (Haier subsidiary) deployed more than 800 AI agents across manufacturing, logistics and supply-chain operations using Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise — including a Brilliant Factory shift-data analysis agent (hours to minutes), a Supplier Collaboration Agent, and a Quality Insights Assistant. [Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise, Agent Platform)]
deployments_detail.value: 800+ AI agents deployed; Supplier Collaboration Agent reduced backorders by 25% across 700+ service-parts suppliers (~27M parts/yr)
